title: Libri Mutationis
description: The Books of Changers, its in latin
body:
Hi, this mod adds two new books to the game, they both change 3 attributes of each individual player who holds them, Size, Gravity, and Speed.

The first book is known as the **Liber Mutatoris Mundi** (The book of the world changer) and the second brings the **Liber Mutatoris Galaxiae** (The book of the galaxy changer), LMG is greater than the LMM but needs the LMM to be made
